create_backup_mephisto_db: create a backup zip archive of the Mephisto database using DBDataPorter
restore_from_backup_mephisto_db: restore the Mephisto database from a previously created backup zip file
export_dump_mephisto_db: export Mephisto database tables to a JSON dump archive with optional task filtering
import_dump_mephisto_db: import Mephisto database data from a JSON dump archive with label and conflict options
export_dump_with_task_filter: export only specific task runs by task name, ID, or date range to a dump archive
